scientific_question: Can the selected recent multimodal-agent-memory baselines be reproduced under their official non-final protocols closely enough to support a later matched AgentEnhance comparison?
estimand: For each baseline, the absolute reproduction gap between an official-source metric and the same metric produced by the frozen upstream code and declared stack.
evidence_already_observed: AgentEnhance has only internal SpaceNet7-derived mechanism evidence.
No public benchmark result from AgentEnhance has been observed.
Source-reported values from Mem-Gallery, V-Mem, CMI, M3-Agent, and MM-Mem were inspected before this freeze.
allowed_surfaces: official benchmark development or documented smoke subsets
official intermediate artifacts explicitly released for reproduction
prohibited_surfaces: AgentEnhance evaluation on any public benchmark
public benchmark final or hidden-test submission
changing the frozen baseline inclusion list after seeing AgentEnhance results
removing failed baselines from the ledger
claiming SOTA from source-reported unmatched numbers
initial_reproduction_order: v-mem retrieve-only smoke on Mem-Gallery non-final subset
secondary video baselines only after the primary harness is accepted
acceptance_rule: ACCEPT a baseline implementation only if the frozen commit is present, the official evaluator runs without schema loss, all expected smoke units are retained, and any numeric reproduction gap is reported rather than hidden. A source-score tolerance is frozen separately only after the exact official artifact and denominator are verified without running AgentEnhance.

outcomes.ACCEPT: The implementation enters the controlled-comparison prefreeze.
outcomes.REJECT_TECHNICAL: Preserve logs and keep the row in the table as reproduction failed; a separately frozen repair may follow.
outcomes.REJECT_SCIENTIFIC: The implementation runs but cannot reproduce the source behavior under its declared protocol; it remains visible and cannot support a superiority claim.
outcomes.INCONCLUSIVE: Required data, model, API, or exact source artifact is unavailable; keep the row and report the missing dependency.

resources.remote_storage_root_class: project-scoped directory on a capacity-approved data volume
resources.network_rule: Large local-to-server files use resumable rate-limited SFTP; upstream git clones and dataset-native download tools are recorded separately.
